Bogthorn's thorn hail is more dangerous than its stab attack - poison with DC 12 CON or paralyze for 1d4.

GMs: Use Bogthorn's thorn hail to paralyze and isolate targets; players, stay out of its near range or face the consequences.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Temporary Hit Points absorb damage before actual Hit Points - they vanish first when you take damage.

DMs: Remind players that Temporary Hit Points absorb the first 17 damage before real Hit Points, and they don't stack.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Dwarves can't be wizards - their racial class identity locks them into martial roles.

Judges: Position your Dwarf to use Shield Brother for +2 AC, reinforcing allies instead of chasing higher damage.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Thief shifts from setup to closer - Backstab makes the pivot with a single attack roll.

GMs: Have the Thief roll for Backstab early, while enemies are unaware, to exploit double damage before chaos ensues.

Find Traps reveals more than players expect - any trap within 120 feet and line of sight.

DMs: Use Find Traps to identify threats within 120 feet and adjust your party's tactical positioning, not just to dodge damage.

Freya's Omen often gets misused as a preemptive safety net - it only lasts 1d6 rounds.

GMs: Make sure players have a high-stakes spell ready before they waste Freya's Omen's 1d6 round duration.

Glabrezu's demonic resilience confounds expectations - it gains a new body instantly if it dies outside.

DMs: Position the Glabrezu outside the Abyss to exploit its Demonic Restoration, forcing players to rethink their strategy.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Cloak of the Mountaineer is more restrictive than it seems - automatic climb success doesn't cover overhangs.

Judges: Remind them that feather fall's one round is for emergencies, not for showboating; save it for when gravity gets personal.

Spell Casting Check failure burns resources faster than players expect - the slot is consumed even if.

GMs: Make them roll a Spell Casting Check for a simple spell early on to hammer home the cost of failure.

DMs: When Inspiring Smite keeps an ally standing, switch to Peerless Athlete for a strength-based assault that shifts momentum.

Luck's impact on Saving Throws isn't universal - only one save type benefits per character.

Judges: Identify each character's Luck-affected save type from their birth augur before the session, and remind players to use it wisely.
